question.en: On a distance-time graph, what does a horizontal straight line segment indicate about the vehicle's motion?
question.ms: Pada graf jarak-masa, apakah yang ditunjukkan oleh bahagian garis lurus mengufuk tentang gerakan kenderaan?

feedback.en: Correct! Distance is not changing, so speed = 0.
feedback.ms: Tepat! Jarak tidak berubah, maka laju = 0 (pegun).

options.text: The vehicle moves at constant speed

feedback.en: Constant speed on distance-time graph is an inclined straight line.
feedback.ms: Laju malar pada graf jarak-masa ialah garis lurus condong.

feedback.en: Acceleration on distance-time graph is a curve.
feedback.ms: Pecutan pada graf jarak-masa berbentuk lengkung.

feedback.en: Moving backwards corresponds to a negative gradient.
feedback.ms: Bergerak ke belakang diwakili oleh kecerunan negatif.

en: Speed is the gradient of a distance-time graph. A horizontal line has gradient 0.
ms: Laju ialah kecerunan graf jarak-masa. Garis mengufuk mempunyai kecerunan 0.

en: Gradient = 0 → Speed = 0 (vehicle is stationary).
ms: Kecerunan = 0 → Laju = 0 (kenderaan pegun).

question.en: On a distance-time graph, a rider travels from distance 20 km to 80 km between time t = 1 h and t = 2 h. What is the speed of the rider?
question.ms: Pada graf jarak-masa, penunggang bergerak dari jarak 20 km ke 80 km antara masa t = 1 j dan t = 2 j. Apakah laju penunggang itu?

feedback.en: 80 is the final distance, not the change in distance.
feedback.ms: 80 ialah jarak akhir, bukan perubahan jarak.

en: Speed = (d₂ - d₁) / (t₂ - t₁).
ms: Laju = (d₂ - d₁) / (t₂ - t₁).

question.en: A food delivery van travels a total distance of 150 km in 2.5 hours. Calculate its average speed.
question.ms: Sebuah van penghantaran makanan meliputi jumlah jarak 150 km dalam masa 2.5 jam. Hitung laju puratanya.

equation: Average Speed = Total Distance / Total Time

en: Divide total distance (150 km) by total time (2.5 h).
ms: Bahagi jumlah jarak (150 km) dengan jumlah masa (2.5 j).

en: Average speed = 150 / 2.5 = 60 km/h.
ms: Laju purata = 150 / 2.5 = 60 km/j.

question.en: On a speed-time graph, what does a horizontal straight line segment represent?
question.ms: Pada graf laju-masa, apakah yang diwakili oleh bahagian garis lurus mengufuk?

feedback.en: Correct! Speed remains unchanged over time.
feedback.ms: Tepat! Laju kekal tidak berubah sepanjang masa.

feedback.en: Stationary is speed = 0 (on the time axis). A horizontal line at speed v > 0 is moving at constant speed.
feedback.ms: Pegun jika laju = 0. Garis mengufuk pada laju v > 0 bermaksud bergerak dengan laju malar.

feedback.en: Acceleration is the gradient; here gradient is 0.
feedback.ms: Pecutan ialah kecerunan; di sini kecerunan ialah 0.

en: On a speed-time graph, horizontal line means speed is not changing.
ms: Pada graf laju-masa, garis mengufuk bermaksud laju tidak berubah.

en: Speed is constant and acceleration = 0.
ms: Laju adalah malar dan pecutan = 0.

question.en: On a speed-time graph, a car's speed increases from 10 m/s to 30 m/s in 4 seconds. What is its acceleration?
question.ms: Pada graf laju-masa, laju sebuah kereta meningkat dari 10 m/s ke 30 m/s dalam masa 4 saat. Apakah pecutannya?

feedback.en: 30 / 4 = 7.5, but remember to subtract initial speed 10.

question.en: A motorcycle decelerates from 25 m/s to a complete stop in 5 seconds. What is its deceleration?
question.ms: Sebuah motosikal mengalami nyahpecutan dari 25 m/s sehingga berhenti sepenuhnya dalam masa 5 saat. Apakah nyahpecutannya?

feedback.en: Acceleration is -5 m/s²; deceleration is stated as a positive magnitude: 5 m/s².
feedback.ms: Pecutan ialah -5 m/s²; nyahpecutan dinyatakan sebagai magnitud positif: 5 m/s².

feedback.en: 25 - 5 = 20 is not the rate of change.

en: Deceleration is the rate of decrease in speed: (Initial - Final) / Time.
ms: Nyahpecutan ialah kadar penurunan laju: (Awal - Akhir) / Masa.

en: Deceleration = (25 - 0) / 5 = 5 m/s².
ms: Nyahpecutan = (25 - 0) / 5 = 5 m/s².

question.en: On a speed-time graph, the motion forms a trapezium with parallel sides of length 10 s and 16 s, and height 20 m/s. What is the total distance traveled?
question.ms: Pada graf laju-masa, gerakan membentuk trapezium dengan sisi selari berukuran 10 s dan 16 s, serta tinggi 20 m/s. Apakah jumlah jarak yang dilalui?

feedback.en: Did you forget the ½ factor in the trapezium area formula?
feedback.ms: Adakah anda terlupa faktor ½ dalam rumus luas trapezium?

feedback.en: 10 × 20 = 200 is only part of the area.

en: Distance = Area under speed-time graph = ½ × (sum of parallel sides) × height.
ms: Jarak = Luas di bawah graf laju-masa = ½ × (hasil tambah sisi selari) × tinggi.

question.en: A vehicle accelerates uniformly from 0 to 12 m/s in 4 s (triangle), then cruises at 12 m/s for 6 s (rectangle). Find the total distance traveled.
question.ms: Sebuah kenderaan memecut secara seragam dari 0 ke 12 m/s dalam 4 s (segitiga), kemudian bergerak pada 12 m/s selama 6 s (segi empat tepat). Cari jumlah jarak yang dilalui.

feedback.en: Correct! Triangle = ½(4)(12) = 24 m; Rectangle = 6(12) = 72 m. Total = 24 + 72 = 96 m.
feedback.ms: Tepat! Segitiga = ½(4)(12) = 24 m; Segi empat tepat = 6(12) = 72 m. Jumlah = 24 + 72 = 96 m.

feedback.en: 72 m is only the constant speed phase.

en: Total distance = Area of triangle (½ × 4 × 12) + Area of rectangle (6 × 12).
ms: Jumlah jarak = Luas segitiga (½ × 4 × 12) + Luas segi empat tepat (6 × 12).

en: Distance = 24 + 72 = 96 m.

question.en: A rider travels 45 km in 45 minutes. What is the speed in km/h?
question.ms: Seorang penunggang bergerak sejauh 45 km dalam masa 45 minit. Apakah lajunya dalam km/j?

feedback.en: 45 km in 45 min means 1 km per minute = 60 km per hour.
feedback.ms: 45 km dalam 45 minit bermaksud 1 km seminit = 60 km sejam.

en: Convert 45 minutes to hours: 45 / 60 = 0.75 hours.
ms: Tukar 45 minit kepada jam: 45 / 60 = 0.75 jam.

question.en: A van starts from rest with acceleration 3 m/s² until it reaches 18 m/s. How long (in seconds) does this acceleration take?
question.ms: Sebuah van bermula dari keadaan pegun dengan pecutan 3 m/s² sehingga mencapai 18 m/s. Berapa lamakah (dalam saat) fasa pecutan ini berlangsung?

feedback.en: Do not multiply speed by acceleration.

en: Use t = (v - u) / a where v = 18, u = 0, a = 3.
ms: Gunakan t = (v - u) / a dengan v = 18, u = 0, a = 3.

question.en: The speed-time graph of a journey forms a trapezium of height 20 m/s, with base t seconds and top (t - 4) seconds. If the total distance is 240 m, find the total time t.
question.ms: Graf laju-masa suatu perjalanan membentuk trapezium berketinggian 20 m/s, dengan tapak t saat dan sisi atas (t - 4) saat. Jika jumlah jarak ialah 240 m, cari jumlah masa t.

question.en: A delivery drone accelerates to maximum speed v in 5 s, cruises for 15 s, and lands in 10 s (total time 30 s). If total distance is 500 m, find the maximum speed v.
question.ms: Sebuah dron penghantaran memecut ke laju maksimum v dalam 5 s, terbang malar selama 15 s, dan mendarat dalam 10 s (jumlah masa 30 s). Jika jumlah jarak ialah 500 m, cari laju maksimum v.

en: Parallel sides are 15 s and 30 s. Area = ½(15 + 30)v = 500.
ms: Sisi selari ialah 15 s dan 30 s. Luas = ½(15 + 30)v = 500.

question.en: Rider A departs from Town P towards Town Q (60 km apart) at 40 km/h. At the same time, Rider B departs from Q towards P at 20 km/h. After how many hours do they meet?
question.ms: Penunggang A bertolak dari Bandar P ke Bandar Q (jarak 60 km) dengan laju 40 km/j. Pada masa yang sama, Penunggang B bertolak dari Q ke P dengan laju 20 km/j. Selepas berapa jamkah mereka bertemu?

feedback.en: Correct! Relative speed = 40 + 20 = 60 km/h. Time = 60 / 60 = 1 hour.
feedback.ms: Tepat! Laju relatif = 40 + 20 = 60 km/j. Masa = 60 / 60 = 1 jam.

feedback.en: In 1.5 h, total distance covered is 60 × 1.5 = 90 km > 60 km.
feedback.ms: Dalam 1.5 j, jumlah jarak ialah 90 km > 60 km.

feedback.en: In 2 hours they would have passed each other long ago.
feedback.ms: Dalam 2 jam mereka telah lama berselisih.

feedback.en: At 0.75 h, distance covered is 45 km < 60 km.
feedback.ms: Pada 0.75 j, jarak dilalui ialah 45 km < 60 km.

en: Since they travel towards each other, combined speed is 40 + 20 = 60 km/h.
ms: Oleh sebab bergerak ke arah satu sama lain, laju gabungan ialah 40 + 20 = 60 km/j.

question.en: A delivery trip has 3 stages: accelerates for 4 s (covers 24 m), cruises for 10 s (covers 120 m), and decelerates for 6 s (covers 36 m). What is the average speed for the ENTIRE 20-second trip?
question.ms: Perjalanan penghantaran mempunyai 3 fasa: memecut 4 s (jarak 24 m), laju malar 10 s (jarak 120 m), dan nyahpecut 6 s (jarak 36 m). Apakah laju purata bagi KESELURUHAN perjalanan 20 saat tersebut?

feedback.en: Correct! Total distance = 24 + 120 + 36 = 180 m. Total time = 4 + 10 + 6 = 20 s. Speed = 180 / 20 = 9 m/s.
feedback.ms: Tepat! Jumlah jarak = 180 m. Jumlah masa = 20 s. Laju purata = 180 / 20 = 9 m/s.

feedback.en: 12 m/s is the cruising speed, not the average speed.
feedback.ms: 12 m/s ialah laju malar, bukan laju purata.

en: Average speed = Total Distance ÷ Total Time = (24 + 120 + 36) / (4 + 10 + 6).
ms: Laju purata = Jumlah Jarak ÷ Jumlah Masa = (24 + 120 + 36) / (4 + 10 + 6).

question.en: Vehicle X reaches 30 m/s in 6 s. Vehicle Y reaches 24 m/s in 4 s. Which vehicle has the GREATER acceleration?
question.ms: Kenderaan X mencapai 30 m/s dalam 6 s. Kenderaan Y mencapai 24 m/s dalam 4 s. Kenderaan manakah yang mempunyai pecutan LEBIH TINGGI?

feedback.en: Correct! a_Y = 24 / 4 = 6 m/s², while a_X = 30 / 6 = 5 m/s².
feedback.ms: Tepat! a_Y = 24 / 4 = 6 m/s², manakala a_X = 30 / 6 = 5 m/s².

feedback.en: Vehicle X has higher final speed, but lower acceleration rate.
feedback.ms: Kenderaan X mencapai laju akhir lebih tinggi tetapi pecutannya lebih rendah.

feedback.en: Both acceleration rates can be calculated precisely.
feedback.ms: Kedua-dua kadar pecutan boleh dihitung dengan tepat.

en: Calculate acceleration for each: a_X = 30 / 6 = 5, a_Y = 24 / 4 = 6.
ms: Kira pecutan masing-masing: a_X = 30 / 6 = 5, a_Y = 24 / 4 = 6.

en: a_X = 5 m/s², a_Y = 6 m/s². Vehicle Y has greater acceleration.
ms: a_X = 5 m/s², a_Y = 6 m/s². Kenderaan Y mempunyai pecutan lebih tinggi.

question.en: In a distance-time graph of Mama's delivery bike, what does a horizontal straight line indicate?
question.ms: Dalam graf jarak-masa bagi motosikal penghantaran Mama, apakah yang ditunjukkan oleh garis lurus mengufuk?

feedback.en: Correct! Distance does not change over time, so speed is zero.
feedback.ms: Tepat! Jarak tidak berubah mengikut masa, jadi laju adalah sifar.

text.en: The bike is moving at constant high speed
text.ms: Motosikal bergerak pada laju seragam yang tinggi

feedback.en: Constant speed is represented by an inclined line.
feedback.ms: Laju seragam diwakili oleh garis condong.

feedback.en: Acceleration would be a curve on a distance-time graph.
feedback.ms: Pecutan ialah lengkung pada graf jarak-masa.

feedback.en: Returning is represented by a downward slope.

en: Gradient of distance-time graph is speed. A flat horizontal line has gradient 0.
ms: Kecerunan graf jarak-masa ialah laju. Garis mengufuk mempunyai kecerunan 0.

en: A horizontal line means distance remains constant as time passes; the vehicle is stationary.
ms: Garis mengufuk bermakna jarak tidak berubah sepanjang masa; kenderaan adalah pegun.

question.en: A scooter travels 60 km in 1.5 hours at a uniform speed. What is its speed?
question.ms: Sebuah skuter bergerak sejauh 60 km dalam masa 1.5 jam pada laju seragam. Apakah lajunya?

feedback.en: Do not multiply distance and time.

en: Speed = Distance ÷ Time = 60 ÷ 1.5.
ms: Laju = Jarak ÷ Masa = 60 ÷ 1.5.

en: Speed = Distance / Time = 60 km / 1.5 h = 40 km/h.
ms: Laju = Jarak / Masa = 60 km / 1.5 j = 40 km/j.

question.en: In a speed-time graph, what does the area under the graph represent?
question.ms: Dalam graf laju-masa, apakah yang diwakili oleh luas di bawah graf?

feedback.en: Correct! Area under a speed-time graph equals distance travelled.
feedback.ms: Tepat! Luas di bawah graf laju-masa mewakili jarak perjalanan.

feedback.en: Acceleration is the gradient of the speed-time graph.
Average speed = Total distance / Total time.
feedback.ms: Laju purata = Jumlah jarak / Jumlah masa.

feedback.en: Rate of change of distance is speed.

en: Units: (m/s) * s = metres (distance).
ms: Unit: (m/s) * s = meter (jarak).

en: The area under any speed-time graph represents the total distance travelled.
ms: Luas di bawah sebarang graf laju-masa mewakili jumlah jarak yang dilalui.

question.en: A motorcycle increases its speed from 10 m/s to 25 m/s in 5 seconds. What is its acceleration?
question.ms: Sebuah motosikal meningkatkan lajunya daripada 10 m/s kepada 25 m/s dalam masa 5 saat. Apakah pecutannya?

feedback.en: 15 is the change in speed, divide by time 5.
feedback.ms: 15 ialah perubahan laju, bahagikan dengan masa 5.

en: Acceleration = (Final speed - Initial speed) / Time.
ms: Pecutan = (Laju akhir - Laju awal) / Masa.

question.en: In a speed-time graph, what does a horizontal straight line represent?
question.ms: Dalam graf laju-masa, apakah yang diwakili oleh garis lurus mengufuk?

feedback.en: Correct! Speed does not change, meaning acceleration is zero.
feedback.ms: Tepat! Laju tidak berubah, bermakna pecutan ialah sifar.

feedback.en: Only stationary if speed is 0. A non-zero flat line is constant speed.
feedback.ms: Hanya pegun jika laju = 0. Garis mendatar bukan sifar ialah laju seragam.

feedback.en: Constant acceleration is represented by an inclined line.
feedback.ms: Pecutan malar diwakili oleh garis condong.

feedback.en: Deceleration is a downward sloping line.
feedback.ms: Nyahpecutan ialah garis cerun ke bawah.

en: On a speed-time graph, a flat horizontal line means speed is constant.
ms: Pada graf laju-masa, garis mendatar bermakna laju adalah malar.

en: A horizontal line indicates the speed remains constant over that duration, so acceleration = 0.
ms: Garis mengufuk menunjukkan laju kekal malar dalam tempoh tersebut, maka pecutan = 0.

question.en: Delivery rider Ah Ming rides 12 km in 20 minutes to deliver food, stops for 10 minutes at the warung, and rides 8 km in 10 minutes. What is his average speed for the entire journey in km/h?
question.ms: Penghantar makanan Ah Ming menunggang sejauh 12 km dalam masa 20 minit untuk menghantar makanan, berhenti selama 10 minit di warung, dan menunggang 8 km dalam 10 minit. Apakah laju puratanya untuk keseluruhan perjalanan dalam km/j?

equation: Average speed = Total distance / Total time

feedback.en: Correct! Total distance = 12 + 8 = 20 km. Total time = 20 + 10 + 10 = 40 min = 2/3 h. Speed = 20 / (2/3) = 30 km/h.
feedback.ms: Tepat! Jumlah jarak = 20 km. Jumlah masa = 40 min = 2/3 jam. Laju purata = 20 / (2/3) = 30 km/j.

feedback.en: Don't omit the 10-minute rest time from the total time!
feedback.ms: Jangan abaikan masa rehat 10 minit daripada jumlah masa!

feedback.en: Check your conversion of minutes to hours.

en: Total distance = 20 km. Total time = 40 minutes = 40/60 hours. Divide distance by hours.
ms: Jumlah jarak = 20 km. Jumlah masa = 40 minit = 40/60 jam. Bahagikan jarak dengan jam.

en: Total distance = 12 + 8 = 20 km. Total time = 20 + 10 + 10 = 40 min = 40/60 h. Average speed = 20 / (40/60) = 30 km/h.
ms: Jumlah jarak = 12 + 8 = 20 km. Jumlah masa = 40 min = 40/60 jam. Laju purata = 20 / (2/3) = 30 km/j.

question.en: A car accelerates from rest to 20 m/s in 4 seconds, travels at 20 m/s for 6 seconds, and decelerates to rest in 2 seconds. What is the total distance travelled?
question.ms: Sebuah kereta memecut dari keadaan pegun sehingga 20 m/s dalam masa 4 saat, bergerak pada 20 m/s selama 6 saat, dan menyahpecut hingga berhenti dalam masa 2 saat. Apakah jumlah jarak yang dilalui?

feedback.en: Correct! Total time b = 4 + 6 + 2 = 12 s. Constant speed time a = 6 s. Distance = 1/2 * (6 + 12) * 20 = 1/2 * 18 * 20 = 180 m.
feedback.ms: Tepat! Jumlah masa b = 12 s. Masa laju seragam a = 6 s. Jarak = 1/2 * (6 + 12) * 20 = 180 m.

feedback.en: 20 * 12 = 240 m would assume 20 m/s for the entire journey.
feedback.ms: 20 * 12 = 240 m mengandaikan laju 20 m/s untuk seluruh perjalanan.

feedback.en: 120 m is only the distance during the constant speed phase.
feedback.ms: 120 m hanya jarak semasa fasa laju seragam.

en: Use area of trapezium: 1/2 * (parallel sides sum) * height = 1/2 * (6 + 12) * 20.
ms: Gunakan luas trapezium: 1/2 * (hasil tambah sisi selari) * tinggi = 1/2 * (6 + 12) * 20.

en: The graph forms a trapezium with parallel sides 6 s and 12 s, height 20 m/s. Area = 1/2 × (6 + 12) × 20 = 180 m.
ms: Graf membentuk trapezium dengan sisi selari 6 s dan 12 s, tinggi 20 m/s. Luas = 1/2 × (6 + 12) × 20 = 180 m.

question.en: A train travelling at 36 m/s applies its brakes and comes to a complete stop in 12 seconds. What is the rate of deceleration?
question.ms: Sebuah kereta api yang bergerak pada 36 m/s menekan brek dan berhenti sepenuhnya dalam masa 12 saat. Apakah kadar nyahpecutan kereta api itu?

feedback.en: Correct! Deceleration rate is positive 3 m/s² (acceleration is -3 m/s²).
feedback.ms: Tepat! Kadar nyahpecutan ialah positif 3 m/s² (pecutannya ialah -3 m/s²).

feedback.en: 'Rate of deceleration' is stated as a positive quantity.

en: Change in speed is 36 - 0 = 36 m/s. Time is 12 s.
ms: Perubahan laju ialah 36 - 0 = 36 m/s. Masa ialah 12 s.

en: Deceleration = (36 - 0) / 12 = 3 m/s².
ms: Kadar nyahpecutan = (36 - 0) / 12 = 3 m/s².

question.en: Convert a speed of 90 km/h into metres per second (m/s).
question.ms: Tukarkan laju 90 km/j kepada meter sesaat (m/s).

en: Multiply by 1000 and divide by 3600 (or divide by 3.6).
ms: Darab dengan 1000 dan bahagi dengan 3600 (atau bahagi 3.6).

question.en: A cyclist's distance-time graph shows: (0, 0) to (2, 30) and then (2, 30) to (5, 30). What was the cyclist's speed between t = 2 hours and t = 5 hours?
question.ms: Graf jarak-masa seorang penunggang basikal menunjukkan: (0, 0) ke (2, 30) dan kemudian (2, 30) ke (5, 30). Apakah laju penunggang basikal antara t = 2 jam dan t = 5 jam?

feedback.en: Correct! Distance remains 30 km between t = 2 and t = 5, so speed is 0 km/h.
feedback.ms: Tepat! Jarak kekal 30 km antara t = 2 dan t = 5, jadi laju ialah 0 km/j.

feedback.en: 30 / 3 = 10 would be if distance changed by 30 km.
15 km/h was the speed in the first 2 hours (30/2).
feedback.ms: 15 km/j ialah laju dalam 2 jam pertama (30/2).

en: Distance at t = 2 is 30 km, distance at t = 5 is still 30 km.
ms: Jarak pada t = 2 ialah 30 km, jarak pada t = 5 masih 30 km.

en: Gradient = (30 - 30) / (5 - 2) = 0 km/h. The cyclist was resting.
ms: Kecerunan = (30 - 30) / (5 - 2) = 0 km/j. Penunggang basikal sedang berehat.

question.en: A speed-time graph starts at (0, 0), increases linearly to (8, 24), remains at speed 24 m/s from t = 8 to t = T, and decelerates to rest at (T + 4, 0). If the total distance travelled is 480 m, find the value of T.
question.ms: Satu graf laju-masa bermula pada (0, 0), meningkat secara linear ke (8, 24), kekal pada laju 24 m/s dari t = 8 hingga t = T, dan menyahpecut hingga berhenti pada (T + 4, 0). Jika jumlah jarak yang dilalui ialah 480 m, cari nilai T.

en: Trapezium parallel sides: top is (T - 8), bottom is (T + 4). 1/2 * (2T - 4) * 24 = 480.
ms: Sisi selari trapezium: atas ialah (T - 8), bawah ialah (T + 4). 1/2 * (2T - 4) * 24 = 480.

question.en: A motorcycle travels from rest to speed v m/s in 6 seconds, and continues at v m/s for another 14 seconds. If the average speed for the entire 20 seconds is 17 m/s, calculate the value of v.
question.ms: Sebuah motosikal bergerak dari keadaan pegun ke laju v m/s dalam masa 6 saat, dan meneruskan perjalanan pada laju v m/s selama 14 saat lagi. Jika laju purata bagi keseluruhan 20 saat itu ialah 17 m/s, hitung nilai v.

equation: Total distance = Average speed * Total time = 17 * 20 = 340 m

feedback.en: Correct! Distance = 1/2(6)(v) + 14v = 3v + 14v = 17v. Total distance = 17 * 20 = 340 m. 17v = 340 => v = 20 m/s.
feedback.ms: Tepat! Jarak = 1/2(6)(v) + 14v = 17v. Jumlah jarak = 17 * 20 = 340 m. 17v = 340 => v = 20 m/s.

en: Total distance = 17 × 20 = 340 m. Also distance = area under graph = 3v + 14v = 17v.
ms: Jumlah jarak = 17 × 20 = 340 m. Jarak juga = luas di bawah graf = 3v + 14v = 17v.

en: Total distance = 17 × 20 = 340 m. Triangle area = 1/2(6)v = 3v. Rectangle area = 14v. Total area = 17v = 340 => v = 20 m/s.
ms: Jumlah jarak = 17 × 20 = 340 m. Luas segi tiga = 3v. Luas segi empat tepat = 14v. Jumlah luas = 17v = 340 => v = 20 m/s.

question.en: Vehicle A and Vehicle B start at the same point. Vehicle A moves at a constant speed of 15 m/s. Vehicle B accelerates from rest at 3 m/s². At what time t will Vehicle B catch up with Vehicle A?
question.ms: Kenderaan A dan Kenderaan B bertolak dari titik yang sama. Kenderaan A bergerak pada laju seragam 15 m/s. Kenderaan B memecut dari keadaan pegun pada 3 m/s². Pada masa t keberapakah Kenderaan B akan mengejar Kenderaan A?

feedback.ms: Pada t = 5: s_A = 75 m, s_B = 37.5 m.

feedback.en: At t = 15: s_B would be far ahead.
feedback.ms: Pada t = 15: s_B sudah jauh ke hadapan.

en: Equate distances: Distance A = Distance B => 15t = 1.5t².
ms: Samakan jarak: Jarak A = Jarak B => 15t = 1.5t².

en: Distance A = 15t. Distance B = 1/2(3)t² = 1.5t². When they meet: 15t = 1.5t² => t = 10 s.
ms: Jarak A = 15t. Jarak B = 1.5t². Apabila bertemu: 15t = 1.5t² => t = 10 saat.

question.en: A food delivery rider travels from Town P to Town Q (45 km away) at 60 km/h, and immediately returns from Q to P at 40 km/h. What is the average speed for the whole round trip?
question.ms: Seorang penghantar makanan bergerak dari Bandar P ke Bandar Q (jarak 45 km) pada laju 60 km/j, dan segera berpatah balik dari Q ke P pada laju 40 km/j. Apakah laju purata bagi keseluruhan perjalanan pergi dan balik?

feedback.en: Correct! t1 = 45/60 = 0.75 h, t2 = 45/40 = 1.125 h. Total t = 1.875 h. Total d = 90 km. Average speed = 90 / 1.875 = 48 km/h.
feedback.ms: Tepat! t1 = 0.75 j, t2 = 1.125 j. Jumlah masa = 1.875 j. Jumlah jarak = 90 km. Laju purata = 90 / 1.875 = 48 km/j.

feedback.en: Average speed is NOT the simple average of speeds (60+40)/2!

en: Do NOT compute (60 + 40) / 2! Compute total distance (90 km) ÷ total time (1.875 h).
ms: JANGAN hitung (60 + 40) / 2! Hitung jumlah jarak (90 km) ÷ jumlah masa (1.875 j).

en: Harmonic mean: Average speed = 2(60)(40) / (60 + 40) = 4800 / 100 = 48 km/h.
ms: Min harmonik: Laju purata = 2(60)(40) / (60 + 40) = 4800 / 100 = 48 km/j.

question.en: A particle moves with speed v(t) = 4t for 0 ≤ t ≤ 5, constant speed 20 for 5 < t ≤ 15, and decelerates uniformly to rest at t = 20. Find the ratio of the distance travelled in the first 5 seconds to the distance travelled in the last 5 seconds.
question.ms: Suatu zarah bergerak dengan laju v(t) = 4t untuk 0 ≤ t ≤ 5, laju seragam 20 untuk 5 < t ≤ 15, dan menyahpecut seragam hingga berhenti pada t = 20. Cari nisbah jarak yang dilalui dalam 5 saat pertama kepada jarak yang dilalui dalam 5 saat terakhir.

feedback.en: Correct! Distance in first 5s = 1/2(5)(20) = 50 m. Distance in last 5s (t=15 to 20) = 1/2(5)(20) = 50 m. Ratio is 50 : 50 = 1 : 1.
feedback.ms: Tepat! Jarak 5 saat pertama = 1/2(5)(20) = 50 m. Jarak 5 saat terakhir = 1/2(5)(20) = 50 m. Nisbah ialah 1 : 1.

feedback.en: Both triangles have base 5 and height 20.
feedback.ms: Kedua-dua segi tiga mempunyai tapak 5 dan tinggi 20.

en: Both the first and last stages are triangles with base 5 seconds and height 20 m/s.
ms: Kedua-dua peringkat pertama dan terakhir berbentuk segi tiga dengan tapak 5 saat dan tinggi 20 m/s.

en: Distance in first 5s = 1/2 × 5 × 20 = 50 m. Distance in last 5s = 1/2 × 5 × 20 = 50 m. Ratio = 50 : 50 = 1 : 1.
ms: Jarak dalam 5 saat pertama = 1/2 × 5 × 20 = 50 m. Jarak dalam 5 saat terakhir = 1/2 × 5 × 20 = 50 m. Nisbah = 1 : 1.
